cohort: The study included 200 mother-newborn pairs from pregnant mothers attending the labor room at Nalanda Medical College & Hospital in Patna.
finding: Maternal anemia significantly impacts the hemoglobin status of the newborn, with statistically significant differences observed in mean cord hemoglobin between newborns from anemic and non-anemic mothers.
cross-section timing: at birth (cord blood and maternal blood collected at delivery)
